verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an 'Ask Expensify AI' feature that gives instant answers, charts, and quarterly flux analysis, and can act on data via plain language (expensify-docs-22, expensify-docs-3, expensify-docs-4), matching the story of AI-generated insights inside the product. However there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of this specific insights feature's quality, and unrelated community reports point to inaccuracies in Expensify's other automated data-extraction (SmartScan/categorization), raising some doubt about overall AI reliability even though not directly about the insights feature. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the Ask Expensify AI insights feature specifically, and details on accuracy/limits of its generated suggestions.
